```{r}

pacman::p_load(tidyverse)

```

```{r}

gapminder <- read.csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/carpentries-incubator/open-science-with-r/gh-pages/data/gapminder.csv')

```

```{r}

chn_gdp <- gapminder %>% 
  filter(country == "China")


ggplot(chn_gdp,
       aes(x = year,
           y = gdpPercap)) +
  
  geom_point()

```
